purpose: Verify the bridge between the R4 XOR-relative logical-sector posterior and Appendix-A Boolean-union first-stage loss, then quantify matched excess Bayes risk of both public first-stage decoders on the complete primitive support.
epistemic_role: Bounded exact observation/loss alignment and algorithmic-gap audit; not a full two-stage decoder benchmark, LER, threshold, or scalable result.

scientific_question.primary: Under the exact Appendix-A first-stage Boolean-union failure rule, how far are the unit-weight O0 and published herald-weight O2 matching decisions from their Bayes-optimal decisions on the same observation layers?
scientific_question.prerequisite: Is the XOR-relative sector posterior used by R4 sufficient for Boolean-union decision loss, or must the exact comparator minimize posterior expected union loss directly over corrections?
possible_outcomes: XOR-relative sectors are loss-sufficient, so the R4 sector Bayes risk is also the exact first-stage decision limit.
XOR-relative sectors are not loss-sufficient, so R4 remains an intrinsic sector-information result and the practical-stage comparator must use direct posterior expected Boolean-union loss.
Either practical first-stage rule attains the matched exact decision limit on the primitive support.
One or both practical rules have positive excess risk, quantifying algorithmic rather than information loss.

matched_design.physical_ensemble: The R4.2 nonwinding physical-error ensemble at p={0.1,0.3,0.5,0.6}.
matched_design.o0: Flux only; compare unit-weight syndrome-only MWPM with the exact O0 Boolean-union decision limit.
matched_design.o2: Flux plus the physically allowed first fusion-charge record; compare published 1-n_e K heralded MWPM with the exact O2 Boolean-union decision limit.
matched_design.action_space: For each flux syndrome, exhaust every binary correction with that boundary. The connected 12-edge fixture is expected to have 2^(E-V+1)=32 actions per syndrome.
matched_design.loss: Loss is one iff any component of the Boolean union of physical error and correction has nontrivial winding, matching the validated Appendix-A first-stage gate.
matched_design.truth_boundary: Physical errors enter only posterior integration and scoring; neither public decoder receives physical-error truth.
matched_design.terminal_winding_rule: Keep physical terminal winding mass outside the conditioned first-stage comparison exactly as in R4.2-R4.3.

estimands: exact O0 minimum posterior expected Boolean-union loss
unit-weight O0 MWPM posterior expected Boolean-union loss and excess risk
exact O2 minimum posterior expected Boolean-union loss
published herald-weight O2 MWPM posterior expected Boolean-union loss and excess risk
exact information gain R*_O0-R*_O2 under the common Boolean-union loss
fraction and probability mass of observations where XOR-relative sectors are or are not sufficient for the complete correction-action loss vector
analysis.r4_bridge_rule: Within each observation, candidates in one XOR-relative sector are loss-sufficient only if their Boolean-union loss is identical for every syndrome-faithful correction. Equality of aggregate R4 sector risk and direct union-loss Bayes risk is reported, not assumed.
analysis.reporting: Report structural counts and observation-probability-weighted risks at each prior. Separate information gain, O0 algorithmic excess, and O2 algorithmic excess.

required: source hashes match the registration freeze
each generated correction has the observed boundary and the affine action set is complete and duplicate-free
both production first-stage corrections belong to the registered action set
production corrections are functions only of their declared O0 or O2 observations
O0 evidence equals the exact marginal over O2 charge refinements
posterior observation evidence and conditional probabilities normalize at both layers
exact Boolean-union Bayes risk never exceeds the matched production risk
XOR-sector loss sufficiency and direct-versus-sector Bayes-risk equality are tested rather than imposed
no post-flux second measurement, physical-truth decoder input, stochastic sample, or larger lattice is introduced

compute_budget.stop_rule: Stop after one complete primitive O0/O2 first-stage loss matrix, exact validations, machine-readable audit, and report update; do not simulate the adaptive second charge round or launch R5.
